title: NIST WebBook: Chlorine is Cl2, molecular weight 70.906 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Chlorine as Cl2, molecular weight 70.906 amu, CAS 7782-50-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Chlorine, CAS Registry Number 7782-50-5, lists molecular formula Cl2 and molecular weight 70.906 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 69.93770536 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Cl2/c1-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
